'
91 Oginome Collection
is a
compilation album
by Japanese singer
Yōko Oginome
. Released through
Victor Entertainment
on December 16, 1990, the album compiles Oginome's singles from 1985 to 1990, plus the new songs "Rock My Love", "This Girl", and "More More Shiawase".
[
1

[

The album peaked at No. 29 on
Oricon
's albums chart and sold over 56,000 copies.
